p0027.evidence:
Trail grades: Trail grades with at least 5 km mapped: green, intermediate. Mapped length by grade within the place's area: 527 km easy (green), 36 km intermediate, 2 km black, 2 km expert. Source: OpenStreetMap mtb:scale (0-1 green, 2-3 intermediate, 4 black, 5-6 expert) and mtb:scale:imba (0-1 green, 2 intermediate, 3 black, 4-5 expert) where mtb:scale is missing, via the QLever OSM planet service.
Easy flow trails: 527 km of easy (green) trail mapped in the place's area gives 10 (none 0, under 20 km 2, 20-50 4, 50-150 6, 150-400 8, over 400 10). Note: OpenStreetMap grades are tagged unevenly between countries.
Bikepacking routes: 0 mountain-bike route relation(s) of 150 km or more in the area gives 0 (none 0, 1 route 3, 2-3 5, 4-6 7, 7 or more 9). Source: OpenStreetMap route=mtb relations.
Day lengths: 567 km of graded trail mapped in the area: a couple of hours from 10 km, half a day from 40 km, full days from 120 km, multi-day with a 150 km route or 600 km of linked network. Gives couple, half, full.
Lift-served bike parks: Left blank: 2 gondola, chairlift or cable-car lifts are mapped but none is tagged for bikes and no bike park was confirmed on a resort page, so 0 would be a guess.
Bike rental: 64 bike rental business(es) found in the area (OpenStreetMap bike shops that rent, plus Overture Maps rental businesses whose names say rent/hire/e-bike; bike-share docking stations removed), e.g. VfJ Werkstätten GmbH, Rent a Bike, Radwelt. Gives 10 (none 0, 1 -> 2, 2-3 -> 3, 4-6 -> 4, 7-10 -> 6, 11-20 -> 8, 21 or more -> 10).
E-bike rental: 4 rental business(es) whose name or listing says e-bike, electric or pedelec (Coolebikes, Rent a Bike Berlin /Tandem/E-Bike, E-bike Tours Berlin/e-bike Und Fahrrad Verleih). Gives 6, same tiers. Shops that rent e-bikes without saying so in their name are not seen, so this can undercount.
